tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists the cities where Siena runs friendship dinners, with the dinner night and time. Siena runs in London only today.

tools.name: list_upcoming_dinners
tools.description: Lists upcoming Siena friendship dinners in a city between two dates, and says which ones are open to book. Siena holds one dinner a week, on Thursday at 7:30pm London time, for small groups of strangers who want to make friends. A few holiday Thursdays have no dinner, and the list leaves them out. B

tools.name: get_dinner
tools.description: Gets one Siena dinner in full: date and time, where it happens, table size, seat price, the booking window and the cancellation rule. The restaurant stays private until Siena emails it on the Wednesday before.

tools.name: how_it_works
tools.description: Explains how Siena friendship dinners work: sign-up, matching, the Wednesday email, the seat price and Premium, cancellation and refunds, and links to the policies.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Returns the link where the person books a seat at a Siena dinner on sienasociety.com. It books nothing and charges nothing. On the website the person signs up or signs in, answers six short questions the first time, and pays for the seat. Never ask for card details or personal data in chat.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dinner · Private data: get_dinner · Public sink: how_it_works.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dinner · Private data: get_dinner · Public sink: how_it_works

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
